editorial:
You follow Tom Ludlow, a tough L.A. cop who bends the rules and carries deep grief over his wife's death. When a fellow officer is killed and evidence points at him, his whole world flips upside down. He has to dig through the police culture he's known forever to find the truth, and along the way he starts doubting everyone around him. The movie has a gritty, tense vibe that pulls you in right away and never lets go.

Keanu Reeves brings a raw, worn-out energy to Tom that makes you feel his pain, and the action scenes hit hard without dragging. The story moves fast and keeps you guessing, though some plot twists can feel a bit predictable. If you enjoy dark crime thrillers with moral gray areas, this one is for you. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Tom discovers that his own captain and fellow officers were behind the corruption and the murder of his partner. The twist reveals that the people he trusted most were the ones setting him up. Tom confronts them in a tense showdown, and instead of walking away clean, he chooses to expose the truth, accepting that his career and life will never be the same again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark crime thrillers with moral gray areas.
